raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Reversals arrive as separate rows with status 'REVERSAL' and an orig_txn_id pointing at the original transaction. The silver filter keeps only status='POSTED', so it drops the reversal rows but keeps the original POSTED transactions they cancel. Totals are therefore overstated for recent days. I could not confirm that every reversal is for the full amount, so this assumes full reversals.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.7,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND txn_id NOT IN (SELECT orig_txn_id FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL)"}}
